title: TypeScript Strict Typing & Interface Conventions
keyTechniques: Define explicit interface or type declarations for all object schemas, props, and API response payloads
Use strict null checks and optional chaining (?.) for potentially undefined properties
Prefer interface over type for extendable object models
Use union types ('active' | 'completed' | 'paused') for status fields rather than raw string primitives
avoid: Do not use 'any' as a catch-all type escape hatch; use 'unknown' with type narrowing if type is dynamic
Do not use non-null assertion operator (!) unless value is guaranteed by prior control flow check
